title: Document deferred source-code licensing posture (keep packages private)
description: The repository source-code license remains intentionally deferred and there is no business decision yet on distribution or commercialization. Rather than choosing a final license prematurely, document the deferred posture explicitly: keep root/core/cli private and unpublished, mark package license metadata UNLICENSED, and add documentation that separates source-code rights from rules-pack/adventure/content licenses. The final license and publish decision is split out into follow-up decision beads. This work is separate from rules/adventure content-source legality.
design:
Approach: do NOT choose a final source-code license now. Instead:
- Keep root/core/cli private (no npm publish).
- Set package license metadata to UNLICENSED for unpublished packages.
- Add docs/licensing.md explaining that no source-code license has yet been granted, and explicitly separating source-code rights from rules-pack/adventure/content licenses.
- Add a release/distribution note: npm publication is deferred pending business/licensing decision.
- Add a CONTRIBUTING note: external code contributions are not accepted yet unless/until contribution licensing is defined.
Defer the actual decisions (distribution channel; commercialization model) to follow-up beads.
acceptance_criteria:
- root/core/cli package.json all remain private (private: true), no npm publish enabled.
- Package license metadata is set to UNLICENSED for the unpublished packages.
- docs/licensing.md exists and states that no source-code license has yet been granted, and explicitly separates source-code rights from rules-pack/adventure/content licenses.
- A release/distribution note documents that npm publication is deferred pending a business/licensing decision.
- A CONTRIBUTING note documents that external code contributions are not accepted yet unless/until contribution licensing is defined.
- Two follow-up decision beads exist: (1) distribution channel; (2) commercialization model.
- Package/format/lint checks pass.
notes: Implemented in PR #164 (branch chore/loreweaver-0jq.26-license-posture). Awaiting review/merge; leaving in_progress until merged per repo PR workflow. Follow-ups: loreweaver-bo2 (distribution channel), loreweaver-14h (commercialization model).
close_reason: Merged via PR #164 (squash) into main; license posture documented.
